sloka: वनान्युपवनानीह लङ्कायाः काननानि च ।सर्वतो गृहमुख्यानि द्रष्टुमागमनम् हि मे ॥५-३-३४॥
transliteration: vanānyupavanānīha laṅkāyāḥ kānanāni ca ।sarvato gṛhamukhyāni draṣṭumāgamanam hi me ॥5-3-34॥

translations.english: "I have arrived here to see Lanka's gardens, groves and forests and also all the important houses".
